english.title: Veterinary surgeon fail to ensure implanted transponder displays a unique code
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a veterinary surgeon who had implanted a transponder into an equine, namely **(..SPECIFY EQUINE..), failed to ensure that the transponder displayed a code that was unique to the transponder
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 13(4), 22(4) and 34 of the Equine Identification (Wales) Regulations 2019.
